players.bio: Oluwatosin Aiyegun (born 26 June 1998), known as Aiyegun Tosin, is a professional footballer who plays for Ligue 1 club Lorient. Born in Nigeria, he plays for the Benin national team.
Alec Georgen (born 17 September 1998) is a French footballer who currently plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 side Paris Saint-Germain.
Alexandre Dujeux (born 8 January 1976) is a French professional football coach and a former defender. He is currently the manager of Ligue 1 club Lorient.

Kan Guy Arsène Kouassi (born 11 September 2004) is a professional football player who plays as a left-back for French Ligue 1 club Lorient. Born in the Ivory Coast, he plays for the Burkina Faso national team. A youth product of New Stars FC, Kouassi moved to Ajaccio's academy in 2021 and was promoted to their reserves in 2022.

Arthur Avom Ebong (born 15 December 2004) is a Cameroonian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Lorient and the Cameroon national team. Club career Avom began his senior career at Cameroonian club Fauve Azur, based in the capital Yaoundé, playing 72 games for the club. There he would be spotted by Lorient in France, with whom he signed a three-year deal with in 2023.
Bandiougou Fadiga (born 15 January 2001) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Lorient.
Benjamin Leroy (born 7 April 1989) is a French professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Lorient.
Bingourou Kamara (21 October 1996) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Lorient. Born in France, he plays for the Senegal national team.

Dembo Sylla (born 10 November 2002) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 team Lorient and the Guinea national team. Career A youth product of Laval since the U9s, Sylla began his career with their reserves in 2019 before signing his first professional contract with the club on 8 August 2022.
Formose Mendy is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a defender for French Ligue 1 club Lorient.
Igor Silva de Almeida (born 21 August 1996), known as Igor Silva or Igor Carioca, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Ligue 1 club Lorient.

Souleymane Isaak Touré (born 28 March 2003) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defender for Ligue 1 club Lorient. On 11 July 2020, Touré signed his first professional contract with Le Havre. He made his professional debut in a 1–0 Ligue 2 win over Amiens on 29 August. On 30 June 2022, Touré signed for Ligue 1 side Marseille on a five-year contract.
Jean-Victor Makengo (born 12 June 1998) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Ligue 1 club Lorient.
Joel Mugisha Mvuka (born 12 November 2002) is a Norwegian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Lorient.
Laurent Abergel (born 1 February 1993) is a French professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Ligue 1 club Lorient.
Mohamed Bamba (born 10 December 2001) is an Ivorian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Ligue 1 club Lorient.

Montassar Omar Talbi (Arabic: مُنْتَصِر عُمَر الطَّالِبِيّ; born 26 May 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Lorient. Born in France, he plays for the Tunisia national team.
Nathaniel Adjei (born 21 August 2002) is a Ghanaian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for Ligue 1 club Lorient and the Ghana national team.

Noah Doriann Cadiou (born 26 October 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder and right-back for Ligue 1 club Lorient. Born in metropolitan France, Cadiou plays for the Guadeloupe national team.

Noah Mbamba-Muanda (born 5 January 2005) is a Congolese professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder and centre-back for Ligue 1 club Lorient, on loan from Bundesliga club Bayer Leverkusen.
Panos Katseris (born 5 July 2001) is a Greek professional footballer who plays as a right-back or a right wing-back for Ligue 1 club Lorient.
Souleymane Faye (born 8 February 2003) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a winger for Ligue 1 club Lorient on loan from Primeira Liga club Sporting CP.
Théo Le Bris (born 1 October 2002) is a Breton professional footballer who plays as a right-back or midfielder for Ligue 1 club Lorient.

Trevan Farooq Sanusi (born 25 April 2007) is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger for French Ligue 1 club Lorient on loan from Premier League club Newcastle United. He is an England youth international.
Yvon Landry Mvogo Nganoma (born 6 June 1994) is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Ligue 1 club Lorient. Born in Cameroon, he plays for the Switzerland national team.
